pairs: Jericho autem clausa erat atque munita,
Now Jericho was closed as well as fortified,
out of fear of the sons of Israel,
et nullus egredi audebat aut ingredi.
and no one dared to depart or to enter.
And the Lord said to Joshua:
Ecce dedi in manu tua Jericho,
I have given Jericho into your hand,
with its king and all the strong men.
Circuite urbem cuncti bellatores semel per diem:
Have all the warriors circle the city once each day;
you shall do so for six days.
the priests shall take the seven trumpets,
quarum usus est in jubilæo, et præcedant arcam fœderis:
which are used on the jubilee, and they shall precede the ark of the covenant.
And you shall circle the city seven times,
and the priests shall sound the trumpets.
And when the voice of the trumpet sounds longer and with interruptions,
and it increases in your ears,
then all the people shall cry out together with a very great shout,
and the walls of the city shall fall to the foundation,
ingredienturque singuli per locum contra quem steterint.
each from a place opposite where they are standing.”
Vocavit ergo Josue filius Nun sacerdotes,
Then Joshua, the son of Nun, called the priests,
et septem alii sacerdotes tollant septem jubilæorum buccinas,
and let seven other priests take the seven trumpets of the jubilee,
and advance before the ark of the Lord.”
He also said to the people,
preceding the ark of the Lord.”
And when Joshua had finished his words,
et septem sacerdotes septem buccinis clangerent ante arcam fœderis Domini,
and the seven priests sounded the seven trumpets before the ark of the covenant of the Lord,
and all the armed soldiers went ahead,
the remainder of the common people followed the ark,
and the sound of the trumpets grew louder everywhere.
But Joshua had instructed the people,
nor shall your voice be heard,
neque ullus sermo ex ore vestro egredietur,
and no word at all shall proceed from your mouth,
donec veniat dies in quo dicam vobis:
until the day arrives on which I will say to you,
Circuivit ergo arca Domini civitatem semel per diem,
Thus, the ark of the Lord circled the city once each day,
et reversa in castra mansit ibi.
and returning to the camp, it remained there.
And so, with Joshua, arising in the night,
the priests took the ark of the Lord,
et septem ex eis septem buccinas,
and seven of them took the seven trumpets,
which are used in the jubilee,
and they preceded the ark of the Lord,
et armatus populus ibat ante eos,
And the armed men went before them,
and the remainder of the common people followed the ark,
and they were blaring the trumpets.
And they circled the city on the second day, once,
and they returned to the camp.
They did so for six days.
Cumque septimo circuitu clangerent buccinis sacerdotes,
And at the seventh circling, when the priests sounded the trumpets,
Joshua said to all of Israel:
Vociferamini: tradidit enim vobis Dominus civitatem.
“Shout! For the Lord has delivered the city to you.
And let this city be anathema,
et omnia quæ in ea sunt,
with all the things that are within it,
May only Rahab the harlot live,
cum universis qui cum ea in domo sunt:
with all who are with her in the house.
For she hid the messengers whom we sent.
Vos autem cavete ne de his,
But you must be careful that you do not touch any of those things,
for then you would be guilty of transgression,
and all the camp of Israel would be under sin
et omnia castra Israël sub peccato sint atque turbentur.
Quidquid autem auri et argenti fuerit,
But whatever gold and silver there will be,
and vessels of brass or of iron,
Domino consecretur, repositum in thesauris ejus.
let these be consecrated to the Lord and be stored in his treasuries.”
Therefore, with all the people shouting,
postquam in aures multitudinis vox sonitusque increpuit,
after the voice and the sound increased in the ears of the multitude,
the walls promptly fell to ruin.
et ascendit unusquisque per locum qui contra se erat:
And each one climbed up at the place which was opposite where he was.
et interfecerunt omnia quæ erant in ea,
And they put to death all who were in it,
the oxen and sheep and donkeys,
et asinos in ore gladii percusserunt.
they struck down with the edge of the sword.
Duobus autem viris, qui exploratores missi fuerant, dixit Josue:
But Joshua said to the two men who had been sent to explore,
“Enter the house of the harlot woman,
and all the things that are hers,
just as you assured her by oath.”
and all her goods and kindred,
et extra castra Israël manere fecerunt.
and they caused them to dwell outside the camp.
Then they set fire to the city
et omnia quæ erant in ea,
and all the things that were within it,
which they consecrated into the treasury of the Lord.
Rahab vero meretricem, et domum patris ejus,
Yet truly, Joshua caused Rahab the harlot,
and all she had, to survive.
And they lived in the midst of Israel,
whom he had sent to explore Jericho.
In tempore illo, imprecatus est Josue,
At that time, Joshua made an invocation,
“Cursed before the Lord is the man who will raise up and rebuild the city of Jericho!
In primogenito suo fundamenta illius jaciat,
and with the last of his children,
et in novissimo liberorum ponat portas ejus.
may he set up its gates.”
And so the Lord was with Joshua,
et nomen ejus vulgatum est in omni terra.
and his name was made known throughout all the land.
